tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for participating in this study. Today, I'd like to ask you some questions about how you use social media. First, if you were to choose a social media platform to use most regularly, which one would you choose, and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你参与本次调研。今天我想问你一些关于你使用社交媒体的问题。首先，如果你要选一个最常使用的社交媒体平台，你会选哪一个，为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Do you think social media is more beneficial for younger people or older people? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：挺有意思的。你认为社交媒体对年轻人更有益，还是对老年人更有益？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Alright. Some people believe that social media can help people stay connected, while others think it can lead to feelings of isolation. What are your thoughts on this? Do you agree or disagree? Why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：好的。有些人认为社交媒体能帮助人们保持联系，而另一些人则认为它会让人产生孤独感。你对此有什么看法？你同意还是不同意？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Finally, do you think social media use will continue to grow in the future, or will people start to limit their usage? What factors do you think will most affect future usage of social media? Explain your thoughts.
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得很有道理。最后，你认为社交媒体的使用量在未来会持续增长，还是人们会开始限制使用时长？你觉得哪些因素会对社交媒体的未来使用情况影响最大？请解释你的观点。
tasks.title: Interview
